title: adonis dentata var. microcarpa
intro: Adonis dentata var. microcarpa, commonly known as Small-fruited Adonis or Chinese Adonis, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to promote wound healing, reduce pain and swelling, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Adonis dentata var. microcarpa include saponins, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
